PluginInfo.Name: VNC (based on RoyalVNC)
PluginInfo.ShortDescription: Connect to Linux, Windows and macOS using VNC.
PluginInfo.Description:
Connect to Linux, Windows and macOS Computers using VNC.

The RoyalVNC based VNC plugin enables you to connect to remote hosts running VNC or Apple Remote Desktop/Screen Sharing.

Security
  • macOS authentication support
  • VNC authentication support
  • UltraVNC MS-Logon II authentication support

Advanced Features
  • Clipboard sharing support
  • Screen scaling support
  • Customizable keyboard behavior
  • Secure Gateway support
